entities.name: Robert Taylor incident
entities.description: Claimed 9 November 1979 encounter of forester Robert Taylor with a 'flying dome' on Dechmont Law, Livingston, Scotland, recorded by police as an assault.

entities.name: Robert Taylor
entities.description: Forestry worker for the Livingston Development Corporation who claimed the encounter.

entities.name: Mary Taylor
entities.description: Robert Taylor's wife, who called the police and a doctor when he came home.

entities.name: Malcolm Drummond

entities.name: Malcolm Robinson
entities.description: Ufologist and author who accepts Taylor's story.

entities.name: Steuart Campbell
entities.description: UFO sceptic who visited the site with police in 1979 and proposed conventional explanations.

entities.name: Patricia Hannaford
entities.description: Founder of the Edinburgh University UFO Research Society and qualified physician who advised Campbell on medical aspects.

entities.name: Steve Donnelly
entities.description: Physicist and editor for The Skeptic who considered the incident explained by an epileptic attack.

entities.name: Phill Fenton

entities.name: The Skeptic

entities.description: Football club near which Taylor's home stood.
